articles.summary: In a world where relocation has become the norm, Pentair has chosen closeness and trust. More than a slogan, "Made in Europe for Europe" is a philosophy that guides every step of our work, from design to delivery. This choice of a European industrial base guarantees the quality, traceability and responsiveness that our partners expect on a daily basis.
articles.title: Made in Europe: local strength for Pentair Pool quality
